from pathlib import Path
from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader

# Create a loader with ./src as the search path
loader = GriffeLoader(search_paths=[Path("./src")])

# Load the package
mypkg = loader.load("mypkg")

# Resolve all aliases (imported and re-exported names)
loader.resolve_aliases()

print(f"Successfully loaded and resolved: {mypkg.name}")
